breakdown.description: Ideal gas equations of state cannot be applied to incompressible liquids
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the ideal gas assumption for the liquid water jet. The ground truth states that ideal gas equations of state (P=ρRT) cannot be applied to incompressible liquids and that the correct approach uses h0 = h + v²/2 with Cp for liquids.
